About this coffee

Half Caff Blend 100% Arabica Speciality Grade Coffee

Provenance

Altitude: 2000 MASL
Location: Colombia
Process: Washed (Sugar Cane decaf process)
Variety: Caturra & Castillo

Tasting Notes

Chocolate / Hazelnut / Orange

Story

Looking for a coffee with less caffeine without compromising on taste? Our Half Caff Coffee delivers the perfect balance, combining regular and decaffeinated speciality coffee to create a smooth, full-bodied cup with around half the caffeine of a standard coffee.

Whether you’re cutting back on caffeine, looking for an afternoon coffee, or simply want a gentler daily brew, half caff coffee offers all the flavour and aroma you expect, with a more balanced caffeine kick. Carefully roasted to highlight the coffee’s natural sweetness and complexity, mixing 50% of our decaf with 50% of Campo Santo to create this blend.

Perfect for coffee lovers who want the best of both worlds, our half caffeine coffee lets you enjoy rich, satisfying flavour from morning through evening, without the intensity of a full-strength cup.

Grind Guide

Whole beans
Recommended for best freshness

Espresso Fine
Suitable for home espresso machines

Moka Pot Fine
Suitable for moka pots and stove tops

Filter Medium
Suitable for V60, chemex, kalita & clever dripper

Cafetiere Coarse
Suitable for cafetiere, french press and electric filter brewers

If you would like you’re coffee ground for a specific brew method or setting, please fill in the addional information box during checkout

How to Store your coffee

We recommend you store your coffee in a cool, dry area away from direct sunlight. Keep them in their original bag, or transfer them to an airtight container.

For the best flavour, enjoy your coffee within three months of the roast date. Avoid storing coffee in the fridge or freezer.

Shipping Information

Complimentary Royal Mail Tracked 48 delivery is available on all UK orders over £45.

At checkout, you can choose between Royal Mail Tracked 24 and Royal Mail Tracked 48 delivery.

Tracked 24 typically arrives within 1–2 working days, while Tracked 48 typically arrives within 2–3 working days. Please allow a little extra time during particularly busy periods.

If your order has not arrived within 14 days, please contact us.
